build.comment: Online MMO desktop shell. frontendDist points at the Vite build for a bundled/offline launcher; for the live MMO the window loads https://crypticrealm.com (see app.windows[0].url). beforeBuildCommand builds the web app first.

bundle.comment: windows/nsis -> Steam-ready installer; also builds macOS .app/.dmg and Linux AppImage/.deb. Icons generated from public/cryptic-realm-logo-512.png via `npx tauri icon`.
